बिद् बिद् or बिन्द् (connected with rts.
भिद्, बिल्, भिल्), cl. 1. P. बिन्दति, बि-
बिन्द, बिन्दिता, बिन्दितुम्, to split, cleave; to
divide; to make or constitute a part.

बिदल, अम्, n. (usually written विदल, q. v., and
according to some fr. वि + दल), anything split off,
a slip, cutting, chip; a split bamboo; a split pea [cf.
[]
मसूर-ब्˚]; a twig; a basket made of split bam-
boos; gold-leaf, &c.; paste of pomegranates; (अस्),
m. pastry, a cake; the tree Bauhinia Variegata
(= कुद्दाल, को-विदार); (आ), f. the plant Ipomœa
Turpethum.
—बिदल-कारी, f., Ved. a woman em-
ployed in splitting bamboos; (Mahī-dhara = वंश-
विदारिणी, वंश-पात्र-कारिणी.)
—बिदल-सं-
हित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. composed or made up of
halves.
—बिदली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, split, cleft, pierced;
द्वि-ब्˚, cleft in twain; (generally spelt विदली-कृत.)
